description: This file contains a class MethodSignatureComparer that implements comparison logic for method symbols, including equality and ordering comparisons based on method signatures, including name, type arguments, and parameter types.

classes.name: MethodSignatureComparer
classes.description: A comparer class for method symbols, implementing IEqualityComparer and IComparer for IMSymbols, with singleton access via Default property.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines if two IMethodSymbol instances have the same signature based on name, type arguments, and parameter types.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for an IMethodSymbol based on its name, type arguments, and parameter types.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Provides ordering comparison for two IMethodSymbol instances based on signature components.
